head_commit.message:
feat: v1.17.0 session R — RELEASE MODE: zero demo purchases + ads fully OFF + store security hardening + double-APK CI

- monetization v4: ADS_ENABLED master switch (OFF for release), purchase() NEVER
  grants fake coins without the native store bridge (polite 'پس از انتشار فعال
  می‌شود' message), simulated-ad overlay + resolver deleted
- shop v4: every demo text removed, rewarded tab auto-hides while ads are off
- word-guess lag v5 (mobile): banner/burst/fx-coin PRE-MOUNTED + class-replay
  (zero DOM creation in the guess frame), commitFound frame-split (board vs
  banner), row-level memoized WordBoard, unused justFound state removed
- splash v6: rAF-lerped progress bar painted by direct transform — silky fill,
  no jumps (user: «نوارها روان پر بشن یهو پرش نکنن»)
- loading characters now match عمو دانا (new seat/rest art, same beret +
  mustache + vest design as the party coach)
- brand-new game icon (عمو دانا + golden tiles): PWA + all android mipmaps
  incl. adaptive foreground + round set
- android security: allowBackup=false, usesCleartextTraffic=false,
  versionCode 3 / versionName 1.17.0
- CI builds TWO APKs per tag: official + AllLevels-unlocked test build
  (NEXT_PUBLIC_ALL_UNLOCKED compile-time flag in save.ts)
- docs/release-guide-fa.md: full Persian publishing guide (Myket/Bazaar
  accounts, keystore signing, store listing, IAP via Poolakey/Myket, Tapsell
  ads activation, checklists)
- verified in browser: boot→name→level→drag (board+banner+coins consistent,
  localStorage single-writer) → shop shows no demo texts and grants nothing

head_commit.message: feat: v1.15.0 session P — ROOT-CAUSE lag & heat engineering: removed the always-on 2.7s ConvolverNode (constant CPU burn = phone heat + starved rendering), fully decoupled coin updates from the render tree (useCoins live pill — word-guess re-render lag GONE), debounced localStorage writes (900ms coalesce + flush on hide), wheel drag rect caching + memoized Wheel/WordBoard, automatic FPS-guard lowfx tier for weak phones, R8+shrinkResources APK diet; NEW exclusive night-gold shop (3 tabs, best-seller ribbon, bonus badges, golden bundle, remove-ads, rewarded-video slot with cooldown + web sim overlay); Myket/Bazaar/AdMob-ready monetization layer (VzBilling/VzAds JSON bridge contract, SKU catalog, graceful simulation mode, README integration guide); brand-new pleasant rhythmic main-menu theme (D-Shur 6/8 santur+ney+tombak, 26s seamless loop, menu2.ogg); invalid SVG vine transforms fixed; lint/tsc clean; full browser test walk green (boot→profile→shop→IAP sim→rewarded ad→map→play→drag→win)
